title: Filipino Sisig with a Herbal Twist
description: A spicy Filipino sisig dish with a vibrant twist, featuring flaxseed-crusted pork and a herbal kick.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together crushed flaxseed and a pinch of salt.
3. Coat the pork pieces with the flaxseed mixture, shaking off excess.
4. Bake the pork in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
5. In a pan, heat some oil over medium heat.
6. Add sliced chili peppers and cook until they start to soften.
7. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute.
8. Add vinegar, lime juice, and vibrant herbal sauce. Stir to combine.
9. Add the cooked pork to the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
10. Serve hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
